reason: Confirmed: exitError (internal/amazon/cdp.go:112) appends up to 2,048 bytes of stderr tail (stderrTailBytes, cdp.go:40), and logText (internal/amazon/browser.go:93) keeps only the first 1,024 bytes, so the newest stderr lines (normally the fatal reason) are dropped when earlier output exceeds about 1 KB. That breaks FR-AMZ-BRET-005 ('with the browser's own reason'). The TC-006 multi-line subtest (browser_retrieval_test.go:604-615) writes 40 lines of about 85 bytes but only checks for 'stub line', so it passes while losing the last line and does not prove the case.

Confirmed: src/components/InformationModal.tsx.new was added in commit 64f47f6 (implement round 0). It is a headless fragment starting at `return (`, imported nowhere, and not part of the specification. It is a stray artifact mixed into this PR and must be deleted.

Confirmed: internal/service/zz_scratch_docs_test.go holds only `package service` and a comment. It compiles, tests nothing and changes no behaviour. It is a locked test-stage file (tests.lock), so the developer cannot remove it in this round. It is cleanup, not a defect.
